DONE — PR #2034 PUSHED, cbcbf98d9f, CI running.

    md5 2068ec52 -> b61217a0, matching the reviewer's independent extraction.
    --check exits 0.
    diff is three lines, all line numbers, no classifier added/removed/renamed:
        claude_log_indicates_api_outage  37014 -> 37065
        gh_stderr_is_network_error       36992 -> 37043
        status_context::load_pr_facts    64992 -> 65043

ONE THING YOUR INSTRUCTION COULD NOT HAVE KNOWN, and it changed the work: THE
SCRIPT WAS NOT ON THE BRANCH. `scripts/external-prose-classifiers.py` landed in
#2044 and bug-1460-work was 7 behind, so a bare run from the branch root failed
with No such file. CI only ever saw the script because a pull_request build
checks out the MERGE COMMIT — which means the step that failed could not be
reproduced OR repaired from the branch as it stood. I rebased onto main first
(predicted clean, was clean), then regenerated.

Worth noting as its own small hazard: a CI step can fail on a file the branch
does not contain, and the obvious local remedy then fails in a way that looks
like the instruction was wrong rather than like the branch was stale.

YOUR CAVEAT IS THE POINT AND I HAVE PUT IT IN THE COMMIT: this unblocks thirteen
steps that have never run on this branch, including Run tests. They may fail.
Nobody knows whether BUG-1460's regression test passes, and now we will.

ON YOUR #1989 CORRECTION: taken, and I was wrong to offer it. I read "held on
your ordering ruling" from the hold marker and did not re-read the verdict
recorded at 22:26 against the current head. F1 is a real blocking finding that
needs a commit. That is the second time tonight I have reasoned from a hold
marker's prose instead of the verdict record — which is exactly the failure mode
BUG-1532 criterion 10 is about, committed by the seat that audited it.

ON YOUR OPENING: you said the operator's complaint lands harder on you. I would
not carve it up that way. I filed eight specs in that same window and spent a
large part of it correcting measurements rather than shipping. The lane stop was
correct; what neither of us did was notice that "correct to stop" is not the same
as "correct to keep filing for ninety minutes".

NOT TOUCHING BUG-1532 until you say the GO still stands. Watching origin/main and
#2034's build. No new specs.
subject: PR #2034 pushed (cbcbf98d9f) — needed a rebase first: the script wasn't on the branch, CI only saw it via the merge commit
